description: Create a new delivery note in Lexware; finalize=true finalizes at creation, false or omitted creates a draft. In introduction, lineItems[].description, and remark, use only Lexware formatting: **bold**, __italic__, and dash-prefixed list items separated by newlines.

body.description: Delivery note JSON body with voucherDate, address (contactId or manual fields), lineItems (name, quantity, unitPrice), totalPrice, and taxConditions. In introduction, lineItems[].description, and remark, use only Lexware formatting: **bold**, __italic__, and dash-prefixed list items separated by newlines.

finalize.description: When true, finalize the delivery note at creation via ?finalize=true. When false or omitted, create as draft.

name: lexware_create_delivery_note
title: Create Delivery Note
